item.title: 'Tragic and senseless': Man arrested in Ohio after two killed in Moore County home, deputies say
item.description: Moore County deputies said a man from Ohio is wanted in connection with a double homicide Saturday morning in the Woodlake community of Vass. Deputies said they believe he fled the county in a white Ford Mustang.
